domain_entities.name: LeaveRequest
domain_entities.purpose: Represents an employee's leave application — the central aggregate of the leave management domain. Tracks the full lifecycle from draft through approval/rejection/cancellation.
lifecycle_states: DRAFT — employee has created but not yet submitted the request; editable by employee only
SUBMITTED — employee has submitted for manager review; no longer editable by employee
UNDER_REVIEW — manager has acknowledged and is actively reviewing the request
APPROVED — manager has approved; leave balance is decremented; terminal state (unless cancelled)
REJECTED — manager has rejected; no balance change; terminal state
CANCELLED — employee cancelled a previously submitted or approved request; if previously approved, balance is restored; terminal state

domain_entities.name: Employee
attributes: managerId: string (UUID | null) — direct manager for leave approvals
domain_entities.purpose: Represents an employee in the organization who can apply for leave and whose manager can approve/reject requests. Holds employment status which gates leave eligibility.
lifecycle_states: ACTIVE — employee is currently employed and eligible for leave
ON_LEAVE — employee is currently on an approved leave
INACTIVE — employee is no longer active (terminated, resigned); leave requests blocked
PROBATION — employee is in probation period; may have restricted leave eligibility

domain_entities.name: LeaveBalance
attributes: entitled: number (total days entitled per policy year)
used: number (days consumed via approved leave)
pending: number (days tied up in submitted/under-review requests)
year: number (calendar year or policy year)
domain_entities.purpose: Tracks an employee's leave balance per leave type per year. Enforces that leave requests cannot exceed available balance. Updated atomically on approval (increment used) and on cancellation of approved leave (decrement used).
lifecycle_states: ACTIVE — balance is current and usable for leave requests
EXHAUSTED — remaining balance is zero; no further leave of this type can be taken
FROZEN — balance is temporarily frozen (e.g., during investigation or policy change)

domain_entities.name: LeavePolicy
attributes: minNoticeHours: number (minimum notice required before start date)
maxCarryForwardDays: number (max days that can carry to next year)
requiresDocumentation: boolean (e.g., sick leave may require a doctor's note)
probationEligible: boolean (whether employees on probation can apply)
entitlementPerYear: number (default annual entitlement in days)
domain_entities.purpose: Defines the rules and constraints for each leave type. Used to validate leave requests (e.g., notice period, max consecutive days, documentation requirements) and to compute entitlements.
lifecycle_states: ACTIVE — policy is in effect and governs leave requests
SUPERSEDED — replaced by a newer version; no longer applied to new requests
DEPRECATED — no longer valid; retained for audit/history

domain_entities.name: LeaveType
domain_entities.purpose: Enumeration of leave categories. Each type has distinct policy rules and balance tracking. Referenced by LeaveRequest, LeaveBalance, and LeavePolicy.

business_rules: BR-001 — Leave Request Submission: An employee may submit a LeaveRequest only if: (a) employee status is ACTIVE, (b) the leave type's LeavePolicy is ACTIVE, (c) the startDate is at least minNoticeHours in the future, (d) totalDays does not exceed maxConsecutiveDays, (e) the employee's LeaveBalance for that type and year has remaining >= totalDays, and (f) no overlapping approved leave exists for the same employee. On submission, status transitions from DRAFT → SUBMITTED and LeaveBalance.pending is incremented by totalDays.

BR-002 — Manager Approval: Only the employee's designated manager (Employee.managerId) may approve or reject a SUBMITTED or UNDER_REVIEW LeaveRequest. On approval: status → APPROVED, LeaveBalance.used += totalDays, LeaveBalance.pending -= totalDays, reviewedAt set to now, managerComment optional. On rejection: status → REJECTED, LeaveBalance.pending -= totalDays (no change to used), reviewedAt set to now, managerComment required.

BR-003 — Leave Cancellation: An employee may cancel their own LeaveRequest if status is SUBMITTED, UNDER_REVIEW, or APPROVED. On cancellation: status → CANCELLED. If previously APPROVED: LeaveBalance.used -= totalDays. If SUBMITTED or UNDER_REVIEW: LeaveBalance.pending -= totalDays. Cancellation is terminal — no further transitions allowed.

BR-004 — Leave Balance Initialization: When a new policy year begins, a new LeaveBalance record is created for each ACTIVE employee per ACTIVE LeavePolicy. entitled is set from LeavePolicy.entitlementPerYear plus any carry-forward from the prior year's remaining (capped at maxCarryForwardDays). used and pending start at 0.

BR-005 — Overlap Prevention: No two APPROVED LeaveRequests for the same employee may have overlapping date ranges. Overlap is checked as: existing.startDate <= new.endDate AND existing.endDate >= new.startDate. This check runs at submission time and again at approval time (in case another request was approved between submission and review).

BR-006 — Emergency Leave Override: Emergency leave bypasses the minNoticeHours constraint from LeavePolicy. All other validations (balance, overlap, employee status, policy status) still apply. This is the only leave type with this override.

BR-007 — Sick Leave Documentation: If LeavePolicy.requiresDocumentation is true (typically for SICK leave exceeding a threshold or per policy), the employee must provide documentation. The LeaveRequest is not eligible for APPROVED state until documentation is verified. A manager may move the request to UNDER_REVIEW while awaiting documentation.

BR-008 — Probation Restriction: Employees with status PROBATION may only apply for leave types where LeavePolicy.probationEligible is true. For ineligible types, the submission is rejected at the domain level.
domain_notes:
## Lifecycle States Introduced

### LeaveRequest
- DRAFT → SUBMITTED → UNDER_REVIEW → APPROVED (terminal, unless cancelled)
- DRAFT → SUBMITTED → UNDER_REVIEW → REJECTED (terminal)
- SUBMITTED → CANCELLED (terminal)
- UNDER_REVIEW → CANCELLED (terminal)
- APPROVED → CANCELLED (terminal)

### Employee
- PROBATION → ACTIVE → ON_LEAVE → ACTIVE (cycle)
- ACTIVE → INACTIVE (terminal)
- PROBATION → INACTIVE (terminal)
- ON_LEAVE → INACTIVE (terminal)

### LeaveBalance
- ACTIVE → EXHAUSTED (when remaining reaches 0)
- EXHAUSTED → ACTIVE (when balance is restored via cancellation or new year)
- ACTIVE → FROZEN (administrative action)
- FROZEN → ACTIVE (administrative unfreeze)

### LeavePolicy
- ACTIVE → SUPERSEDED (new version created)
- ACTIVE → DEPRECATED (policy retired without replacement)
- SUPERSEDED → DEPRECATED

## Key Domain Decisions
- LeaveBalance tracks `pending` separately from `used` to prevent double-booking during the review window
- Emergency leave bypasses minNoticeHours but all other validations remain
- Overlap check runs at both submission and approval time to handle race conditions
- Cancellation of an APPROVED leave restores the balance (used decremented)
- LeavePolicy is versioned via effectiveFrom/effectiveTo; only one ACTIVE policy per leave type at any time
- Employee.managerId is the single source of truth for the approval chain — no delegation or escalation modeled in this slice
- LeaveType is a simple enum (ANNUAL, SICK, EMERGENCY) with no lifecycle; extensibility left to future cycles
